result.instructions: Tools for NextAgency, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which cases are still Prospects, and who owns them?"; "Show the open tasks of the case for Jane Smith, with their due dates."; "Find the contact with the phone number 5551234567.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes NextAgency data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nextagency_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nextagency_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nextagency_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nextagency_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nextagency_get_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: The NextAgency user the token acts as: id, name, email and role. Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: nextagency_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The agency's users (brokers and staff): id, name, email, role. Use the id as assigned_to in nextagency_create_case_task.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the last page.

tools.name: nextagency_list_cases
tools.title: List cases
tools.description: The cases the token can see, one page at a time: id, case number, name, sales status, stage, owner, market segment. Filter by sales status (for example Prospect or Client) or by case number. Use the id with the other case tools.

sales_status.description: Only cases with this sales status, for example Client.

case_number.description: Only the case with this number (the number the portal shows).

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the last page.

tools.name: nextagency_search_cases
tools.title: Search cases
tools.description: Cases whose name, number or contact details match the query, one page at a time.

query.description: The search text, for example a surname or a case name.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the last page.

tools.name: nextagency_create_case
tools.title: Create a case
tools.description: WRITE: create a new case. Give a name, or a first name for an individual (market_segment individual). The API checks the whole request first: an invalid request stores nothing. Returns the new case.

name.description: The case name (required unless market_segment is individual).

tools.name: nextagency_create_case_note
tools.title: Add a case note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to one case. Use the title for a short label and the body for the text. Returns the new note.

pinned.description: Pin the note to the case summary.

tools.name: nextagency_create_case_task
tools.title: Add a case task
tools.description: WRITE: add a task to one case. The due date uses the format of the vendor example: DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM AM UTC. assigned_to takes user ids from nextagency_list_users. Returns the new task.

stage.description: The task stage, for example To Do.

type.description: The task type, for example Other.

due.description: The due date, DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM AM UTC.
